svg.text: D1 BAT54WS · K left / A right
Populated R3: 10 kΩ from +3V3 to UART_RX.
Activity LEDs and protection stay on PCB; see board reference.
Internal paths are PCB relationships, not field wires.
USB Mini-B J5 supplies bridge; no Vdd backfeed.
USB assembly route is not an individual wire or cavity.
Host and UART J1: all ten contacts carried; non-UART signals are unused. UART J2 chain unused.
J3.2 / J3.6 are NC; J3.3 optional 5 V is unconnected. No bridge Vdd connection.
Connector symbols preserve source numbers, not native pitch or mating orientation. Verify 3.3 V logic before energizing.
P11 controller artwork / checked P12 J33 allocation. Physical mapping, artwork lint and actual page viewer remain OPEN.
